contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE LAETAAE PRINC PERP ; D/ IMP CONSTANTINIVS MAX AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I. AD319, (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE LAETAAE PRINC PERP. Reverse shows Victories holding wreath on shield. Mint is London. See RIC VII, p.106, no.154. Obverse shows Helmeted, cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads IMP CONSTANTINIVS MAX AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//PLN.
